selection_reasoning: These tasks form a natural multi-hop chain. In Minecraft, orange concrete powder is crafted from gravel, sand, and orange dye — so gravel is thematically and spatially linked to orange concrete powder. The scene can be designed so that the agent must first locate gravel in the environment, and then navigate from that area to find and mine the orange concrete powder block. The 'find gravel' task serves as an exploration/navigation prerequisite that guides the agent toward the area where orange concrete powder can be mined. This creates a meaningful spatial dependency chain where completing the first task provides orientation needed for the second.

edges.reason: Gravel is a crafting ingredient of orange concrete powder; finding gravel leads the agent to the nearby orange concrete powder deposit to mine

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate near the gravel deposit and face it. Target is the center of the gravel patch at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5). Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player must walk at least ~2 blocks from spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~7.07 blocks). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking toward the gravel.

Uses inventory_has because mining orange concrete powder causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. Orange concrete powder always drops itself (unlike gravel which can drop flint), making this a reliable check. The block breaks instantly by hand — no tool needed.

scene_description: A grass platform with a gravel deposit leading toward a sand area where orange concrete powder blocks are placed. An oak log/plank structure sits near spawn for environmental context. The gravel patch (3x4 blocks plus 2 trail blocks) is positioned 4-7 blocks from spawn, requiring the agent to walk toward it. Beyond the gravel, a sand area (4x5 blocks) holds orange concrete powder blocks (2-tall stack plus 2 ground-level blocks). The layout creates a natural exploration flow: spawn → gravel → sand → orange concrete powder.
task_text: Explore the area to find gravel blocks on the ground, then navigate past them to locate and mine the orange concrete powder blocks.

Sand area at (~8-11, 0, 7-11). Orange concrete powder at (~9,0-1,9) as 2-tall stack plus (~10,0,9) and (~10,0,10) at ground level. Oak structure at (~-2 to ~-3, 0-2, -1 to 3). All within 15-block radius. Nearest gravel ~5 blocks from spawn (requires movement). Orange concrete powder ~13 blocks from spawn (requires navigation through gravel area).
